_comment: Art direction for Kithbound — the one place to re-skin the whole game. 'palette' is the shared set of colors the world AND the characters draw from; edit these to change the entire look. 'light.dir' is a single direction everything is lit from (up-left by default), which is what makes the scene feel cohesive — highlights land on that side, shadows fall opposite. 'characters'/'entities' choose procedural drawing or your own art: set render to 'sprite' and point 'sprite' at a res:// image to drop in art you made yourself (a missing file silently falls back to procedural). Trees take it further: instead of one 'sprite' they can name a 'trunk' and a 'canopy' image, and only the canopy sways in the wind while the trunk stays planted (see tools/gen_trees.py). Colors are [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] in 0..1. Presentation-only: none of this touches game logic.

entities._tree_comment: The grove (tools/gen_trees.py over tools/pixelart/trees.py): seeded round trees, oaks, birches, pines, a willow, fruit and blossom trees and a rare autumn one, each a trunk + a swaying canopy. Scenery picks one per tree by hashing its position, so neighbours rarely match; list a name more than once to make it commoner. A world's art block may replace the list (Nocthollow grows its own).
entities._understory_comment: Bushes and stumps scattered as y-sorted scenery around the trees and in open ground (WorldArt picks the spots on the pixel ground, Scenery plants them). 'types' are understory_<type>.png under 'prefix'; 'density' scales how many. Decoration only: nothing collides with them.
entities._ground_comment: The pixel-art GROUND (GroundLayer + assets/ground.gdshader, tiles from tools/gen_ground.py). render 'pixel' draws the floor from seamless pixel tiles at one texel per world unit; 'flat' (or a missing tile) keeps the classic gradient + noise. 'ramps' colour the tiles' four shade roles, darkest first: grass is the default floor, lush/meadow/dirt show through in noise-mapped 'patches' (scale = how big, threshold = how rare, 0..1; baked once per world into small noise textures), 'clump' is the light/dark mottling (scale, and the dark/light cut-offs), sand rims the water, path is a trail's packed earth and worn the trampled grass along it. 'accents' colour a meadow's tiny flowers. 'details' + 'details_index' are the scattered litter (tufts, pebbles, leaves, reeds, lily pads...); scatter.density scales how much and scatter.grass_tint re-tints the tufts and clover. A world's art block can override any of it.
entities._ambient_life_comment: The small life in the air (AmbientLife): butterflies by day that rest now and then and fade out at dusk; fireflies that blink on as dusk deepens ('always' keeps them lit, for a night world); huge soft cloud shadows drifting with the wind over everything; leaves letting go of on-screen trees ('rate' per tree). Set a count or rate to 0 to turn one off. Cosmetic and local: nothing here is networked.
entities._water_comment: Water is a SURFACE, not a silhouette: one seamless tile (tools/gen_water.py) that WorldArt tiles across each pond/river/pool and scrolls a texel at a time. 'tile' names the image; 'world_tile' is how many world units one tile spans (bigger = chunkier pixels); a missing tile falls back to the old flat fill. See tools/pixelart/water.py.
entities._portal_comment: A neutral (grayscale) energy oval (tools/gen_portal.py); WorldArt tints it per-portal with the portal's own color and keeps the breathing pulse + orbiting sparks procedural. A missing file falls back to the procedural shimmering ovals.
entities._hedge_comment: A seamless leafy tile (tools/gen_hedge.py) tiled along the maze's axis-aligned hedge walls: the shaded front face (tile darkened) + the sunlit top (tile shifted up). world_tile is how many world units one tile spans. A missing file falls back to the flat-green procedural hedges.
entities._props_comment: Small hand-placed props as baked pixel-art (tools/gen_props.py). For each type listed, WorldArt loads prop_<type>_base.png (fixed materials) and, if present, prop_<type>_tint.png (the part whose color is data, drawn tinted by the prop's own color). Any missing file falls back to that prop's procedural drawing. Remove a type from the list to force procedural.

_form_highlight_comment: C-3 — the form HINT LAYER. Objects the companion's current daemon form could act on wear a soft, breathing pool of that form's colour on the ground, so switching shape changes what lights up. Which objects qualify is game logic (an object's per-form 'affordances' map); only the look lives here. 'colors' is keyed by species; anything unlisted uses 'default'. Turn the layer down by lowering 'alpha' (0 hides it entirely).
_daycycle_comment: A slow ambient drift from day to dusk and back, driving the warm wash (DayTint) and the vignette. enabled=false freezes it at the first stop (today's static look). period_sec is one full day->dusk->day round trip when loop=true. Set enabled=false to turn it off.
